note.en: Cost and accumulated depreciation reconciled from the opening to the closing carrying amount. Required by IAS 16.73(e). Closing balance = opening + additions - disposals + transfers + revaluation + other for every component; Accumulated depreciation and impairment is stated positive and deducted. The closing total must equal the adjusted balance of Property, plant and equipment (LS-PPE) read above; the paper computes the schedule and shows the difference.
note.ar: يشترطه IAS 16.73(e). الرصيد الختامي = الافتتاحي + الإضافات - الاستبعادات + التحويلات + إعادة التقييم + أخرى لكل مكوّن؛ ويُذكر المكوّن المقابل موجباً ويُخصم. يجب أن يساوي الإجمالي الختامي الرصيد المعدّل لـ Property, plant and equipment (LS-PPE) المقروء أعلاه؛ وتحسب الورقة الجدول وتعرض الفرق.

note.en: Cost and accumulated amortisation reconciled from the opening to the closing carrying amount. Required by IAS 38.118(e). Closing balance = opening + additions - disposals + transfers + revaluation + other for every component; Accumulated amortisation and impairment is stated positive and deducted. The closing total must equal the adjusted balance of Intangible assets and goodwill (LS-INTG) read above; the paper computes the schedule and shows the difference.

note.en: The carrying amount reconciled from the opening to the closing balance. Required by IAS 40.76 and 40.79(d). Closing balance = opening + additions - disposals + transfers + revaluation + other for every component. The closing total must equal the adjusted balance of Investment property (LS-INVP) read above; the paper computes the schedule and shows the difference.
note.ar: يشترطه IAS 40.76 and 40.79(d). الرصيد الختامي = الافتتاحي + الإضافات - الاستبعادات + التحويلات + إعادة التقييم + أخرى لكل مكوّن. يجب أن يساوي الإجمالي الختامي الرصيد المعدّل لـ Investment property (LS-INVP) المقروء أعلاه؛ وتحسب الورقة الجدول وتعرض الفرق.
